lines:
flowchart TD
    A[User selects an existing project portable repository] --> B[Resolve candidate through anchored project-relative paths]
    B --> C[Bounded parse of repository, session, branch and snapshot manifests]
    C --> D{Supported format and required features?}
    D -- No --> Q[Inspect-only quarantine report; no semantic apply or continuation]
    D -- Yes --> E[Verify exact hashes, schemas, forbidden fields and object limits]
    E --> F{Segments, checkpoints, artifacts and lineage valid?}
    F -- No --> Q2[Quarantine affected branch; preserve safe diagnostics and unaffected branches]
    F -- Yes --> G{Multiple child head claims from one checkpoint?}
    G -- Yes --> H[Expose explicit branch alternatives; never sort or merge by timestamp]
    G -- No --> I[Issue VerifiedPortableBranchHandleV1]
    H --> I
    I --> J[Extract logical capability and workspace requirements]
    J --> K[Build complete UnresolvedBindingInventoryV1]
    K --> L{All local bindings explicitly selected and compatible?}
    L -- No --> M[Remain inert and inspectable/searchable; show unresolved categories]
    L -- Yes --> N[Core Project and Configuration Coordinator validates local candidates]
    N --> O[Core Authority Engine compiles fresh manifest and user-visible authority summary]
    O --> P{User explicitly accepts fresh local authority?}
    P -- No --> M
    P -- Yes --> R[Snapshot Freezer creates immutable child continuation snapshot]
    R --> S[Core Event Committer creates or advances explicit portable child branch]
    S --> T[Recovery continues from committed checkpoint without replaying prior effects]
    Q --> Z[No install, enable, credential import, approval inheritance, artifact execution or side-effect replay]
    Q2 --> Z
    M --> Z

data.title: Inert import, unresolved bindings, fresh authority, and explicit continuation
